name: phd-bachelors-before-estimate-not-an-award-term
description: Credit-transfer review 2026-10-28 (#17): a standalone Purdue master’s transcript gives the bachelor’s only as “Before Fall 2023” (DGS 2026-09-20), stored as Summer 2023. A graduate course from another source dated Summer 2023 was refused as “taken in the term your bachelor’s degree was awarded (Summer 2023)” — a term the student never gave. It now asks for the semester instead: “not counted yet — dated before Fall 2023, and this record knows only that your bachelor’s degree was awarded before then …”.
